artifact:
Feature: Admin manage specialities and doctors

  As an admin, I want to manage specialities and doctors in the system
  so that I can maintain a well-organized medical staff

Scenario Outline: Adding, updating, and deleting specialities
  Given I am an admin with access to the specialities management system
  When I add a new speciality
  Then the speciality should be added successfully
  When I view an existing speciality
  Then I should see the details of the speciality
  When I update an existing speciality
  Then the speciality details should be updated successfully
  When I delete a speciality
  Then the speciality should be deleted successfully

Scenario Outline: Maintaining doctors
  Given I am an admin with access to the doctor management system
  When I associate a doctor with a speciality
  Then the doctor should be associated successfully
  When I disassociate a doctor from a speciality
  Then the doctor should be disassociated successfully

Examples:
  | Speciality Name | Speciality Description | Doctor Name | Doctor Speciality |
  | Cardiology      | Heart diseases          | Dr. Smith   | Cardiologist       |
  | Neurology       | Brain disorders         | Dr. Jones   | Neurologist       |

Scenario Outline: Adding a new speciality
  Given I am an admin with access to the specialities management system
  When I add a new speciality
  Then the speciality should be added successfully
  And the speciality should be unique

Examples:
  | Speciality Name |
  | Cardiology      |
  | Neurology       |

Scenario Outline: View and update the details of an existing speciality
  Given I am an admin with access to the specialities management system
  When I view an existing speciality
  Then I should see the details of the speciality
  And the speciality details should be updateable

Examples:
  | Speciality Name | Speciality Description |
  | Cardiology      | Heart diseases          |
  | Neurology       | Brain disorders         |

Scenario Outline: Delete a speciality
  Given I am an admin with access to the specialities management system
  When I delete a speciality
  Then the speciality should be deleted successfully
  And the speciality should not have any doctors attached

Examples:
  | Speciality Name |
  | Cardiology      |

Scenario Outline: Add a new doctor
  Given I am an admin with access to the doctor management system
  When I add a new doctor
  Then the doctor should be added successfully
  And the doctor should have a speciality

Examples:
  | Doctor Name | Doctor Speciality |
  | Dr. Smith   | Cardiologist       |
  | Dr. Jones   | Neurologist       |

Scenario Outline: Disassociate a doctor from a speciality
  Given I am an admin with access to the doctor management system
  When I disassociate a doctor from a speciality
  Then the doctor should be disassociated successfully
  And the doctor should not have any speciality attached

Examples:
  | Doctor Name | Doctor Speciality |
  | Dr. Smith   | Cardiologist       |
  | Dr. Jones   | Neurologist       |

Feature: Admin manage specialities and doctors

  Scenario: Adding a new speciality
  Given the admin is logged into the system
  When the admin adds a new speciality "Cardiology"
  Then the speciality "Cardiology" should be added to the system

  Scenario: Viewing and updating an existing speciality
  Given the admin is logged into the system
  When the admin views the speciality "Cardiology"
  Then the speciality "Cardiology" should be displayed with its details
  When the admin updates the speciality "Cardiology"
  Then the updated details should be saved

  Scenario: Deleting a speciality
  Given the admin is logged into the system
  When the admin deletes the speciality "Cardiology"
  Then the speciality "Cardiology" should be removed from the system
  But if there are doctors attached to "Cardiology"
  Then the deletion should be prevented

  Scenario: Adding a doctor to a speciality
  Given the admin is logged into the system
  When the admin adds a doctor to the speciality "Cardiology"
  Then the doctor "John Doe" should be associated with "Cardiology"
  But if "Cardiology" does not exist
  Then the addition should be prevented

  Scenario: Updating doctor information
  Given the admin is logged into the system
  When the admin updates the information of doctor "John Doe"
  Then the updated information should be saved
  But if "John Doe" is not associated with any speciality
  Then the update should be prevented

  Scenario: Deleting a doctor from a speciality
  Given the admin is logged into the system
  When the admin deletes the doctor "John Doe" from "Cardiology"
  Then the doctor "John Doe" should be removed from "Cardiology"
  But if "John Doe" is not associated with any speciality
  Then the deletion should be prevented

Feature: Admin manage specialities and doctors

  As an admin, I want to manage specialities and doctors in the system
  so that I can maintain a well-organized medical staff and services

Scenario Outline: Adding, updating, and deleting specialities
  Given I am an admin with access to the specialities management system
  When I add a new speciality
  Then the speciality should be added successfully
  When I view an existing speciality
  Then I should see the details of the speciality
  When I update an existing speciality
  Then the speciality details should be updated
  When I delete a speciality
  Then the speciality should be deleted if no doctors are attached

Examples:
  | Speciality name | Speciality type | Description |
  | Cardiology     | Medical         | Heart-related |
  | Neurology      | Medical         | Brain-related |
  | Dermatology    | Medical         | Skin-related |

Scenario Outline: Maintaining doctors
  Given I am an admin with access to the doctor management system
  When I add a new doctor
  Then the doctor should be added successfully
  When I associate a doctor with a speciality
  Then the doctor should be linked to the speciality
  When I remove a doctor from a speciality
  Then the doctor should be removed if no specialities are linked

Examples:
  | Doctor name | Speciality |
  | Dr. Smith   | Cardiology |
  | Dr. Jones   | Neurology |
  | Dr. Brown   | Dermatology |

Scenario Outline: Adding a new speciality
  Given I am an admin with access to the specialities management system
  When I add a new speciality
  Then the speciality should be added successfully
  And no existing speciality should be modified

Examples:
  | Speciality name | Speciality type | Description |
  | Cardiology     | Medical         | Heart-related |
  | Neurology      | Medical         | Brain-related |
  | Dermatology    | Medical         | Skin-related |

Scenario Outline: View and update an existing speciality
  Given I am an admin with access to the specialities management system
  When I view an existing speciality
  Then I should see the details of the speciality
  And the speciality should not be modified
  When I update an existing speciality
  Then the speciality details should be updated
  And the speciality should not be modified

Scenario Outline: Delete a speciality
  Given I am an admin with access to the specialities management system
  When I delete a speciality
  Then the speciality should be deleted if no doctors are attached
  And no existing speciality should be modified

Scenario Outline: Maintaining doctors
  Given I am an admin with access to the doctor management system
  When I maintain doctors
  Then I should be able to add, associate, and remove doctors
  And no specialities should be linked to a removed doctor

Scenario Outline: Add a new doctor
  Given I am an admin with access to the doctor management system
  When I add a new doctor
  Then the doctor should be added successfully
  And no existing doctors should be modified

Scenario Outline: Associate a doctor with a speciality
  Given I am an admin with access to the doctor management system
  When I associate a doctor with a speciality
  Then the doctor should be linked to the speciality
  And no existing doctors should be modified

Scenario Outline: Remove a doctor from a speciality
  Given I am an admin with access to the doctor management system
  When I remove a doctor from a speciality
  Then the doctor should be removed if no specialities are linked
  And no existing doctors should be modified
